claims.statement: Retain the exact T22 counterexample to the broader all-rank pointwise nonpositivity shortcut.
claims.scope: An eligible rank p=34=x+2 in the broader all-rank domain; p is not alpha-2, and the complete aggregate is negative.
claims.reason: The independent T22 coefficient formulas give alpha=68, x=32, all 67 original leaves favorable, one +212336130412243110 summand, and negative complete sum -498754180547001418536. The phenomenon was already recorded in r24, so no novelty is claimed.

claims.statement: The C1-F1 evidence does not settle the universal first-interior aggregate sign.
claims.scope: Frozen all-ordinary-tree target p=alpha-2 under x+2<=p; reviewed experiments consist of two T-family target instances and orders 2 through 8 with no eligible trees.
claims.reason: T22 and T60 have exact eligible complete sums -147807 and -2947590. The small sweep has zero eligible rows. No universal proof or positive eligible complete sum follows. The source report's labeled-tree total is misstated: the per-order counts sum to 280392, not 275392.

claims.statement: For every m>=1, the T_m family has alpha=3m+2; at p=alpha-2=3m all 3m+1 original leaves are favorable and S=-q^2+4q-(q+1)*binom(q,2)<0, where q=3m.
claims.scope: Exact restricted-family target-rank identity for T_m; the eligibility guard is required when using it as an instance of the frozen target, and no all-tree conclusion follows.
claims.reason: Root decomposition and original-support deletion give explicit independence-polynomial identities in the report. Their top coefficients prove both strict selector signs and the summand formula for every m>=1; binom(q,2)>=q for q>=3 proves negativity.

limitations: The new T_m formula covers only one explicit family, even when its members satisfy target eligibility.
The order-2-through-8 sweep has no eligible target rows and gives no target-sign evidence.
The broader-rank positive individual summand is historically known and is not a positive complete aggregate at p=alpha-2.
No Lean build was run and no universal proof or in-scope positive complete counterexample was supplied.
